purpose: views-only-item: (a) HEAD 411fa3f (built twice, A/A) against 5b2d6ef, bench/runtime.cpp of HEAD over the include/ of each commit; (b) lazy::at with a position_index (normal and core_deterministic) against plain lazy::at on maps of 8, 32 and 128 pairs; sid
rule: HEAD is slower when both HEAD binaries lie above 5b2d6ef and the gap to the nearer one is above the A/A of the cell
steal_rule: a round whose steal is above 0.1 percent of the CPU time is excluded from every median
order: each round runs every cell of every binary once, as its own process, in an order from shuf
binaries: rt.*: one binary per arm and compiler; every operation and document of runtime.cpp is one cell (main renamed to a cell function, return 0 added; a driver main picks the cell by its first argument). ix.*: one binary per arm, compiler and pair count; arm1 plain lazy::at, arm1_AA the same built again, arm2 position_index with core_deterministic false, arm3 with core_deterministic true. The index holds the keys of pair first, middle, middle+1 and last, read with lazy::find from the same message. Each lookup includes lazy::from of a cold copy. Keys k000, k002, ...; the missing key lies between pair middle and middle+1.
